description: One grouped PR per week for everything non-major; majors arrive on their own and wait for a human.
The operator under test and the kind node image are treated like majors regardless of their SemVer type:
valkey-operator broke its v1alpha1 API in most 0.x minors, so a bump must be read against the scenarios,
and a kindest/node image only works with the kind release that built it, so it moves with the kind CLI pin.
GitHub Actions pins float on major tags on purpose, so no digest pinning: config:recommended leaves pinDigests off.

packageRules.description: Low-risk updates land on their own once CI is green.
Majors need a human to read the changelog, so label them and leave them.
The operator under test: every bump is read against the scenarios before it merges.
A kindest/node image is built for one kind release; bump kind and the node image together.

customManagers.description: Operator packs annotate every pinned version the same way, so one manager serves every pack.
kind node images are digest pinned per kind's release notes.
kind-action installs the kind version named here; the local kind comes from the package manager.
mkdocs-material is pinned in ci.yml and docs.yml and both must agree.
Versions the Dockerfile downloads itself carry a renovate comment on the line before their ARG.
golangci-lint pin, read by the CI action and by task lint.
yamllint is installed at this pin in ci.yml.
actionlint is installed at this pin in ci.yml.
